incidents.name: Sheep reflection-token pair drain
incidents.notes: SHEEP is a reflective deflationary token whose deliver() shrinks the reflected supply and so raises the liquidity pair's balance without a sync(), letting the attacker swap the inflated balance out for WBNB.

sources.ref: onchain review: SHEEP 0x0025B42bfc22CbbA6c02d23d4Ec2aBFcf6E014d4 created 2021-04-29T04:13:50Z by 0xe641310e834a250086bd741b380fd7a60bae03c4, unrelated to attack sender 0x638b4779d1923cedf726ed4d717ee4169df53d4e; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: 9.5436 WBNB left the SHEEP/WBNB pair; 9.5436 WBNB x $307.02 at incidentTimestamp 1676025500 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $2,930.
